description: GJ-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for Ahmedabad city, specifically serving the West and Central zones. Located at Subhash Bridge, it is one of the busiest RTOs in Gujarat, handling vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for a significant portion of the state's largest city.
address: Near Subhash Bridge, Sabarmati, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

description: The GJ-02 RTO serves the Mehsana district in Gujarat, acting as a primary hub for vehicle registration and licensing in the North Gujarat region. It is a critical office for the district's significant dairy and industrial transport sectors, managing a high volume of commercial and private vehicle documentation.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Sardar Dairy, Palavasna, Mehsana, Gujarat

description: The GJ-03 RTO serves the Rajkot district in Gujarat, acting as a major hub for vehicle registration and licensing in the Saurashtra region. It is one of the busiest transport offices in the state, handling a high volume of both private and commercial vehicle certifications.
address: Near Marketing Yard, Porbandar Highway, Rajkot, Gujarat - 360003

description: The GJ-04 RTO is the Regional Transport Office responsible for the Bhavnagar district in Gujarat. It plays a vital role in the Saurashtra region, overseeing vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road safety enforcement for this major trade and industrial center.
address: RTO Office, Gadhechi Vadala, Bhavnagar, Gujarat

description: The GJ-05 RTO office serves the metropolitan area of Surat, one of India's largest commercial hubs for textiles and diamonds. It is responsible for vehicle registration, licensing, and enforcing transport regulations within the Surat Municipal Corporation limits. Given the city's high population density and economic activity, this is one of the most active transport offices in Gujarat.
address: Regional Transport Office, Behind Krushi Mangal Hall, Near Majura Gate, Ring Road, Surat, Gujarat
